title: Negative Order Item Quantity Allowed Resulting in Negative Balances
symptom: When an authenticated client submitted an order payload with item quantity <= 0 (e.g. quantity: -5), the service accepted the order, returned 201 Created, and calculated a negative total balance.
root_cause: The OrderItem schema lacked a Pydantic ge=1 constraint and the service did not perform manual boundary verification before computing subtotals.
regression_test_requirement: Every test suite targeting POST /orders must explicitly test quantity = -1, -5, and 0, verifying that the endpoint deterministically rejects the request with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity.
